synthetic_reproducer.description: Verifier-equivalent local synthetic repo/suite contained every current REQUIRED_EXACT_MODULES entry plus Stage-B durable_replay/provider_intent tests, while omitting the fresh Agent regressions listed below. Current coverage logic still returned PASS because those modules are not REQUIRED_EXACT_MODULES.

fresh_confirmed_omitted_regressions.boundary: Malformed delegated model replies must fail before tool side effects or model-state mutation.
Uncertain local side effects must not be classified as provider failover errors.
A legitimate identical tool retry without provider call_id must get a fresh local call identity rather than collide with prior execution.
Returning to an old provider client after account movement must rebase full local history rather than resume a stale remote thread.
Reservation-aware transport/reselection semantics must remain fail-closed across account movement.
Responses affinity/thread state must survive legitimate cooldown failover without carrying the old thread to the replacement account.
Parallel child lifecycle/admission/cleanup semantics must remain covered.

required_action_for_core: Before Windows readiness, the same-byte final suite and/or coverage verifier must explicitly require these current-head runtime-safety regressions (or a stronger byte-equivalent set). A PASS from coverage blob 42cdae4c alone is insufficient if the suite omits them.
ownership: Audit only. NOTION_AGENT did not mutate Core verifier/readiness, pair/materializers, PR#7, PR#8, CircleCI, Windows, live Notion/Codex, accounts, secrets, main, merge, or production.
